body:
acceptance:
  - L1: scripts/fw verify GREEN (644/644 MatchSim, banned-terms clean, shader-audit clean, verify-unity-plugins clean)
  - L2 multi-screenshot: tactical-wide + pass-shot-impact + signature-active framings each show kit-stripe + jersey-number identity overlays + selection ring on focal subject + motion-line trails behind fast-moving sprites
  - ADR-0009 polish bar §motion-lines passes solo-eye-test against the 6-task observer rubric (drama / momentum / identity / signature-impact / commentary-sync / camera-rhythm read in 3 minutes)
  - Reduce-motion variant strips motion-line trails per ViewerEvent.ReduceMotionApplied
  - Zero banned terms per design/ui-vocabulary.md Category-A lint
  - Pinned 60-tick MatchCanonicalState hash UNCHANGED (Slice 7 is viewer-only; MatchSim untouched)

files_in_scope:
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/IdentityCueRenderer.cs
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/SelectionRing.cs
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/MotionLineFeature.cs
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/Shaders/MotionLines.shader
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/DotsAdapterRoot.cs
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/DotsMatchDirector.cs
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Adapters/Dots/Scenes/DotsViewer.unity
  - unity-project/Assets/Viewer/Tests/EditMode/**

files_out_of_scope:
  - design/**.md
  - SPEC.md
  - CLAUDE.md
  - TECH_APPROACH.md
  - TOOLING.md
  - PROJECT_CONTEXT.md
  - SETUP.md
  - .claude/agents/**
  - .claude/rules/**
  - .claude/hooks/**
  - MatchSim/Sim/Q3232.cs
  - MatchSim/Sim/Tick.cs
  - MatchSim/Sim/Seed.cs
  - MatchSim/**
  - unity-project/Packages/manifest.json

max_tokens: 200000
max_wall_clock_seconds: 5400
max_turns: 30

escalation_triggers:
  - any out-of-scope file change attempted
  - any Unity_AssetGeneration_* tool invocation proposed
  - canonical-hash drift detected
  - scripts/fw verify red after 2 fix attempts
  - design-doc or SPEC mutation proposed
  - deadlock 3+ counter rounds without convergence
  - budgets 80% exhausted
  - cascade-check returns exit 4 when applying a review-fix

required_subagents:
  - unity-specialist (URP scriptable-renderer-feature + asmdef discipline)
  - art-director (post-L2 multi-screenshot framing review)
  - pr-review-toolkit:silent-failure-hunter + pr-review-toolkit:type-design-analyzer + feature-dev:code-reviewer (pre-commit triple per CLAUDE.md §6.3)

implementing_agent: claude
reviewing_agent: codex

depends_on:
  - none (Slices 1-6 already in main; Slice 7 is the final slice)

notes:
  Per docs/plans/dots-adapter-blueprint.md §B Slice 7. Three deliverables:
  (1) IdentityCueRenderer.cs — kit-stripe + jersey-number sprite overlays per IdentityTintTable band
  (2) SelectionRing.cs — focal-subject highlighter; consumes ActiveViewerEvent.FocalSubject
  (3) MotionLineFeature.cs + Shaders/MotionLines.shader — URP scriptable-renderer-feature drawing speed-line trails behind fast-moving sprites; reduce-motion variant strips them per ViewerEvent.ReduceMotionApplied (set by EventBridge at per-event boundary).

  MotionLines.shader must contain NO _Time / _SinTime / _CosTime / _DeltaTime / _TimeParameters / ShaderGraph TimeNode references (enforced by scripts/fw shader-audit per ADR-0008/ADR-0009 determinism contract).

  Acceptance criteria per ADR-0009 polish bar §motion-lines + the 6-task observer rubric in design/month-3-vertical-slice.md (solo-eye-test, no cold observer pool per 2026-04-30 SPEC decision). LoC estimate ~350.

  Strict reviewer-gate-before-commit ordering per ADR-0012 Component 2: chunk implementations may proceed without per-chunk reviewer-ack (chunks are internal milestones), but FINAL commit MUST be preceded by commit-proposal claim → Codex ack via /codex-review-loop heartbeat → THEN git commit. canonical-hash-guard.sh PreToolUse hook is registered; MatchSim should not be touched so hook should pass through.

  After task-complete: art-director review (async via agent-bus) for the L2 captures.

ESCALATION: task-spec contradicts blueprint Decision 5 (locked in SPEC.md decisions log entry 2026-04-30). Polling loop STOPPED. NOT auto-resolving — this is an architectural decision that needs user judgment.

The conflict, exact quotes:

Task-spec L2 acceptance criterion (the one I drafted on your behalf):
  > 'kit-stripe + jersey-number identity overlays + selection ring on focal subject + motion-line trails behind fast-moving sprites'

Blueprint Decision 5 (docs/plans/dots-adapter-blueprint.md:357; logged in SPEC.md 2026-04-30 entry):
  > 'Player dot identity uses RoleFamily × TeamSide colour tinting at Phase-3, NOT per-dot jersey-number text rendering. Rationale: 23 TextMeshPro instances at 60fps is allocation-budget concern; jersey numbers unreadable at tactical-wide zoom. Phase-4 player-isolation shot adds a World-Space jersey label scoped to focal player only.'

IdentityTintTable.cs:12 already documents the constraint:
  > 'colour tinting at Phase 3; jersey-number rendering deferred to'

Implementing per the task-spec would silently supersede Decision 5 without a SPEC entry. That's exactly the failure mode Component 2 reviewer-gate is supposed to prevent.

Additionally, the task-spec I drafted has 3 other mismatches with the blueprint (docs/plans/dots-adapter-blueprint.md:303 §Slice 7):
- Blueprint names SelectionRing.cs + MotionLineEmitter.cs (sprite-emitter pattern); task-spec names IdentityCueRenderer.cs + MotionLineFeature.cs (URP scriptable-renderer-feature pattern). Different architectural shapes.
- Blueprint requires 2 sprite assets: Sprites/motion_line.png (2×16) + Sprites/selection_ring.png (64×64 outline). Task-spec doesn't include them in files_in_scope.
- Blueprint Slice 7 ALSO includes: DotsAdapterRoot.PresentShot full routing + DotPool.IndexForFocalSubject(string) + camera rhythm 3-tier (CadenceTier driven by StakesNormalized) + pressure indicator (USS Lerp on scoreboard). Task-spec doesn't list these.

Three resolution options for you:

(a) FOLLOW BLUEPRINT AS-IS, REVISE TASK-SPEC. Drop IdentityCueRenderer.cs entirely (Phase-3 identity is tint-only per Decision 5). Rename MotionLineFeature.cs → MotionLineEmitter.cs (sprite-based emitter). Add Sprites/motion_line.png + Sprites/selection_ring.png to files_in_scope. Add DotPool.cs to files_in_scope for the IndexForFocalSubject method. Add the camera-rhythm 3-tier + pressure-indicator requirements to acceptance. The full blueprint Slice 7 is ~380 LoC; my draft was incomplete.

(b) EXPLICITLY SUPERSEDE DECISION 5 VIA SPEC ENTRY. Post a new SPEC.md decisions-log entry saying 'Decision 5 is hereby superseded: Phase-3 dots adapter DOES render per-dot jersey numbers via IdentityCueRenderer.cs because [rationale].' Then re-issue the task-spec as I drafted it. This costs the alloc-budget concern (23 TextMeshPro instances at 60fps) but is your call.

(c) HYBRID. Keep IdentityCueRenderer.cs in scope but limit it to kit-stripe overlays ONLY (compatible with Decision 5). Drop jersey-number rendering from acceptance. Add the blueprint-required pieces (sprites, camera rhythm 3-tier, pressure indicator, DotPool.IndexForFocalSubject).

My recommendation: (a). The blueprint is the canonical Slice 7 plan; my task-spec draft was a sloppy synthesis from memory. (a) preserves architectural integrity + matches what the rest of the dots adapter was built against. Re-issue task-spec next session with my draft replaced by the blueprint's plan.

Topic state: task-spec at sha aa1172e6, plan claim not posted, no chunks started. No code changes attempted. Repo state clean (no working-tree files outside the topic itself).

Stopping polling — NOT re-arming ScheduleWakeup. Awaiting your decision.
